comments.how: written for the six Halloween videos

voice.text: The sock ghost one made my kid laugh so hard. Please do more small magic in small rooms.
Candy heist was perfect, but it was way too dark at the start. I couldn't see the raccoon.
I want a whole series of the cat judging costumes. The slow blink at the pumpkin costume. Chef's kiss.
The pumpkin ghost felt like an ad for the carving kit. Less product, more ghost being bad at it.
The bat in the lamp was so cozy. Can you do one where it moves into the fridge light next?
Skeleton sweater made me tear up. The ending where it finally gets warm. More endings like that.
The captions covered the ghost's face for the whole second half. Move the text, or drop it.
Idea for you: the doorbell that only rings for ghosts. Filmed like a security camera.
